info.title: Cisco-IOS-XE-bgp-rib-oper
info.description:
This module contains a collection of YANG definitions
     for BGP RIB operational data.It provides detailed
     information about BGP paths, attributes, and their status
     within the BGP RIB.
     Copyright (c) 2020, 2024-2025 by Cisco Systems, Inc.
     All rights reserved.

Cisco IOS-XE operational state data (read-only).
**Category:** Routing Protocols
**Paths:** 21

parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

prefix.description: The BGP prefix associated with the route entry.

ni-type.description: The type of network instance (e.g., VRF, global) associated with the route entry.

ni-name.description: The name of the network instance associated with the route entry.

afi-safi.description: The address family identifier (AFI) and subsequent address family identifier (SAFI) for the route entry.

src-orig.description: The origin of the BGP path, indicating how the path was learned.It is either the source protocol or the neighbor address.

nbr-addr.description: The neighbor address from which the BGP path was learned.

if-name.description: Contains interface name if the next-hop is a link-local address, empty otherwise.

src-rd.description: The source route distinguisher associated with this path if this path was imported from another vrf, empty otherwise.

src-ni-name.description: The name of the network instance associated with this path if this path was imported from another vrf, empty otherwise.

path-id.description: A unique identifier for the BGP path, used to differentiate between multiple paths for the same prefix.

path-st.description: The current status of the BGP path.

rpki-st.description: The RPKI (Resource Public Key Infrastructure) status of the BGP path.

mpls-in.description: The MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) label for incoming traffic on the path.

mpls-out.description: The MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) label for outgoing traffic on the path.

sr-prof-name.description: The Segment Routing (SR) profile name associated with the path.

sr-bg-sid.description: The Segment Routing (SR) binding SID (Segment Identifier) for the path.

sr-lbl-indx.description: The Segment Routing (SR) label index for the path.

attr-idx.description: Index to the BGP attribute associated with the path.

comm-idx.description: Index to the BGP community associated with the path.

extcomm-idx.description: Index to the BGP extended community associated with the path.

lrgcomm-idx.description: Index to the BGP large community associated with the path.

avail-paths.description: The number of available BGP paths for the prefix, indicating the different routes that can be used to reach the destination.

as-value.description: The Autonomous System (AS) number value associated with the BGP path.

nh.description: The next-hop IP address for the BGP route, indicating the immediate next router to which packets should be forwarded.

metric.description: Metric associated with the path, used for determining the best path among multiple available paths.

lp.description: Local preference for this path, used to prefer one path over another within the same AS.

weight.description: Path weight, a Cisco-specific attribute used to select the best path when multiple paths are available.

origin.description: Path origin, indicating how BGP learned about the route (IGP, EGP, or INCOMPLETE).

aa.description: Attribute indicating whether or not the prefix is an atomic aggregate, meaning it has been summarized.

aggr-as-num.description: AS number of the autonomous system that performed the aggregation of the route.

aggr-as4-num.description: AS4 number of the autonomous system that performed the aggregation of the route.

aggr-addr.description: IP address of the router that performed the aggregation of the route.

orig-id.description: The router ID of the originator of the route in the local AS, used in route reflection.

ext-aigp-metric.description: The accumulated IGP metric for the path, used for comparing paths based on IGP metrics.

path-cnt.description: Path count, indicating the number of paths available for the route.

items.description: The reflection path the route has passed, listing the cluster IDs of route reflectors.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BGP large community.
